classifier.name: Labware & deck occupancy
classifier.objective: Identify labware occupying each visible Flex deck slot. Label transparent labware only when its structure is identifiable; label empty only when the entire slot footprint is verifiably unoccupied. Route ambiguous, obscured, or unsupported views to manual review rather than forcing a class. Split data by capture session to prevent leakage.

classes.name: Empty slot
classes.description: The entire slot footprint is sufficiently visible to confirm that no labware is present. Check for transparent rims, walls, wells, and reflections before assigning this label.
classes.exclude: Any labware, including transparent labware. Shadows, glare, occlusion, or fixtures that prevent confirming absence require manual review.

classes.name: Tip rack
classes.description: A pipette tip rack occupies the slot, with or without tips. Transparent or partially obscured racks qualify only when visible structural features unambiguously identify a tip rack and its slot.
classes.exclude: Tube racks and microplates. Tip count is irrelevant. Uncertain identity, slot assignment, or ambiguous stacks require manual review.

classes.name: Microplate
classes.description: A well plate occupies the slot, including PCR or deep-well plates. Transparent or partially obscured plates qualify only when visible well and plate structure unambiguously establishes identity and slot assignment.
classes.exclude: Tip racks and reservoirs. Glare, occlusion, or stacks that make identity or slot assignment ambiguous require manual review.

classes.name: Reservoir
classes.description: A reagent reservoir occupies the slot. Transparent or partially obscured reservoirs qualify only when visible walls and compartment structure unambiguously establish identity and slot assignment; liquid visibility alone is insufficient.
classes.exclude: Microplates, waste containers, and empty slots. Uncertain identity, slot assignment, or ambiguous stacks require manual review.

classes.name: Tube rack
classes.description: A rack for individual tubes occupies the slot. Transparent or partially obscured racks qualify only when visible rack structure unambiguously establishes identity and slot assignment.
classes.exclude: Pipette tip racks and well plates. Uncertain identity, slot assignment, or ambiguous stacks require manual review.

classes.name: Other labware
classes.description: Clearly identifiable labware occupies the slot and demonstrably falls outside the other defined labware classes. Transparent items qualify only when sufficient structure is visible to make that determination.
classes.exclude: Not a fallback for uncertain identity. Obscured or ambiguous views, uncertain slot assignments, ambiguous stacks, and hardware modules require manual review.
